speech.heard: Jordan has 52.3% women in senior and middle management. India has 11.9%. This counts only senior and middle management, excluding all junior roles. Afghanistan has 5.9% the world's lowest. Jordan has 8.9 times the share Afghanistan has. Other leaders include Botswana at 48.2%, Montenegro at 48.1% and Malawi at 47.7%. Major economies vary. The USA has 44.1% while Japan has 14.5%. The global median is 33.4%. Brazil is above that with 38.7%. What is your country land?
